title: The Link Library WordPress plugin before 7.10.0 does not re-check the selected library's own login requirement when…
description: The Link Library WordPress plugin versions prior to 7.10.0 contain a vulnerability where the plugin fails to re-check the login requirement of the selected library during front-end link submissions. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to submit links to libraries that are configured to require login by reusing a form token from another library that does not require login.
